opening.argument: The video centers on preparing for a Citibank internship, as its title identifies the subject as “How I Prepared And Cracked The Citibank Internship Interview.” The discussion explains ordinary recruitment and preparation: “the process of CITY involved group discussions followed by a personal interview,” while interview research involved “reading about these companies what new trends are there in the industry.” It also describes actual internship work involving “data visualisations, representations and analytics using various software.” This is career guidance and personal experience, not a request for payment, investment participation, credentials, or another financial action. The channel-subscription request is ordinary audience engagement and is not tied to receiving an investment or employment benefit.
